jsCalibrationUpdates.policy: Raise only the same actual platform map from completed CI_FILE_TIMING records with success === true. The red/cancelled containing run is not a passing suite. Failed/missing/local observations never populate these hosted platform maps; unmeasured inputs retain their existing fallback.

Raise only successful completed per-file hosted observations on their actual platform. Failed raw workers, failed JS files, and unfinished fixtures are excluded. No current pass/full-suite claim, execution cache, safety classification, fallback or timeout change.

Raise only same-platform complete success:true CI_FILE_TIMING records for the nine new Host families. A failed/cancelled containing job is not a passing suite; unobserved families retain fallback. No old cost decreases, local/censored estimates, execution cache, safety classification, matrix or timeout changes. Placement calibration alone does not establish that the unchanged job budgets now pass.
Complete same-platform success:true native per-file ceil/max; explicit old values and unknown fallback never decrease. No passing overall group claim.

Raise only native same-platform completed unique assigned-file success:true CI_FILE_TIMING observations by ceil/max. Failed and unfinished files and nested timings are excluded; a failed/cancelled containing job or step is not a passing suite. Old costs, rawLua safety/placement, unknown,initial,timeouts,workers and concurrency are unchanged.

luaShardCalibrationUpdates.policy: Raise placement-only luaShard estimates from actual completed hosted Windows raw Lua worker timings. A timer in a failed worker is not success. Exclude every matching Lua worker failure and all unfinished fixtures. The original lua safety map, unknown fallback, >=10000ms exclusive classification, two-worker cap and all fixture/job deadlines remain unchanged.

Raise only successful completed per-file hosted observations on their actual platform. Failed raw workers, failed JS files, and unfinished fixtures are excluded. No current pass/full-suite claim, execution cache, safety classification, fallback or timeout change.
Placement only: ceil/max against old luaShard ?? unchanged lua safety ?? unknown fallback. Every raw outer step completed/success; exclude JS-embedded timings. No deadline/worker eligibility change.
